# <span id="aanchor99"></span> Dashboard

The customizable dashboard allows you to display and arrange links to frequently used tasks, exception data for specified lists, gain/loss balance information for locations, and "Did you know?" tips for improving your FLOWCAL experience.

All of these features are customizable using the [Dashboard Manager](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager.md).

Your dashboard can expand horizontally to accommodate quick launch tiles and tools. If you have enough items in your dashboard, a scroll bar will display at the bottom of your dashboard, allowing you to scroll left and right.
